Obviously, with JetSmarter you're going to avoid the time and indignity of traditional airport check-in. It's

We're not just another charter company. Far from it. We've "rewired" private aviation to create a marketplace

Complimentary Empty Legs/JetDeals: JetSmarter members have access to an unlimited amount of 
complimentary empty leg flights. This means that you can bring friends, family, or co-workers with you for no extra cost

as a JetSmarter member. We make our money off of memberships, not on a trip by trip basis! 
Jet Shuttle: Members have access to seats on a jet shuttle between New York City and Fort Lauderdale FL, NYC 
to Hampton's, LA to Las Vegas, San Francisco to Los Angeles, Fort Lauderdale to Las Vegas, Fort Lauderdale to LA, NYC to 
Vegas, NYC to LA, NYC to San Fransisco, NYC to Chicago, Chicago to Fort Lauderdale, Chicago to Los Angeles, NYC to Boca 
Raton, Atlanta to NYC, and Atlanta to Boca Raton 
Members can book their seat on the shuttles complimentary Each member has 2 tokens to book with 1 token to 
book the flight there and one to book flight back, once you are on the plane you get your token back to keep booking. 
Coast to coast trips (flights over 4 hours) take 2 reservations to book one way so once you are on the aircraft you can 
then book your return flight. Remember you get each of your reservations back once on flight so can keep booking as 
many times as you like. There are additional cost for non member seats which you can use your flight credits to 
purchase. Members can also create their own shuttle and bring additional guests choosing the times the flights leave, 
this would be cheaper then chartering your own plane. Whatever seats you don't use will open up in the app and be free
